in_arabic.name: رضوان
in_arabic.meaning: رضوان اسم معنی ہے جو اللہ کے ملائک اور جنتیوں کا نام ہے
in_arabic.long_meaning: رضوان اسم ہے جو اللہ تعالیٰ کے ملائک اور جنتیوں کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے، رضوان کا معنی ہے 'رضا مند' یا 'خوشی'، یہ نام قرآن مجید میں ذکر ہوا ہے، خاص طور پر سورہ زمر میں

in_urdu.name: رضوان
in_urdu.meaning: رضوان کا مطلب ہے ملائک اور جنت کا نام، اللہ کی رضا
in_urdu.long_meaning: رضوان ایک ایسا نام ہے جو ملائک اور جنت کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے، اس کا مطلب ہے 'اللہ کی رضا' یا 'خوشی'، یہ نام عربی मूल سے ہے اور اسلامی تقویم میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خصوصاً شیعہ مسلمانوں میں

in_hindi.name: रिज़वान
in_hindi.meaning: रिज़वान का अर्थ है देवदूत और स्वर्ग का नाम, ईश्वर की कृपा
in_hindi.long_meaning: रिज़वान एक ऐसा नाम है जिसका उपयोग देवदूतों और स्वर्ग के लिए किया जाता है, इसका अर्थ है 'ईश्वर की कृपा' या 'आनंद', यह नाम अरबी मूल से है और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में महत्व रखता है

in_pashto.name: رضوان
in_pashto.meaning: رضوان د ملائکو او جنت نوم دی، د الله رضا
in_pashto.long_meaning: رضوان داسې نوم دی چې د ملائکو او جنت لپاره کارول کېږي، د دې معنی دے 'د الله رضا' یا 'خوشۍ'، دا نوم د عربي ريښې څخه دی او د افغان او پښتون دودیزو کې مهم دی

in_english.name: Rizvan
in_english.meaning: Rizvan means satisfaction or pleasure, related to angels and paradise
in_english.long_meaning: Rizvan is a name derived from Arabic roots, specifically from the word 'رضا' (rida), meaning 'satisfaction' or 'pleasure', it refers to the satisfaction of Allah and is associated with angels and paradise, mentioned in the Quran, particularly in Surah Zumar, symbolizing divine pleasure and bliss

pronunciation.urdu: اردو میں تلفظ کی تفصیل رضوان (rizwān)
pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل رضوان (ṛizwān)

data.cultural_impact: The name Rizvan holds great significance in Islamic culture, particularly in connection to the Mawlid Al-Nabi celebrations. The Mawlid is the Prophet Muhammad's birthday, and Rizvan is believed to be the day on which the Prophet received his first revelation from Allah. This day is hence considered a day of joy and spiritual renewal for Muslims worldwide.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Rizvan lies in its association with the sacred promises and covenants made between Allah and his prophets. Muslims believe that the name reflects Allah's unwavering commitment to his promises and His care for His believers. Additionally, the name serves as a reminder of the promise of Paradise that Allah extends to those who follow His guidance and fulfill the requirements of their faith. The name Rizvan thus embodies the concepts of faithfulness, trust, and divine grace, offering spiritual comfort and motivation to those who bear the name or simply contemplate its meaning.

historical_references.reference: Rizwan was the name of the Persian warrior who defeated the Roman general Valerian in 260 AD during the Battle of Edessa. Rizwan is believed to have been a vassal of the Sassanid king Shapur I and is celebrated in Persian and Islamic literature as a hero.
historical_references.context: War between the Roman and Persian Empires

historical_references.reference: Rizwan is also the name of the Caliph Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz who ruled the Islamic Caliphate from 717 to 720 AD. He is known for his piety, justice, and efforts to promote unity among Muslims and is considered one of the Rightly Guided Caliphs.

modern_usage.modern_context: Rizvan, also known as Eid al-Fitr, is an Islamic holiday celebrated by Muslims around the world to mark the end of Ramadan, the Islamic holy month of fasting. With the increasing globalization, Rizvan has become a trending topic on social media platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter. On these platforms, Muslims share photos and videos of their celebrations, including traditional foods, clothing, and greetings. The use of hashtags such as #RamadanMubarak and #EidMubarak have made it easier for people to follow and engage in the festivities virtually. Additionally, there are various online marketplaces where people can purchase Rizvan-related items such as new clothing, decorations, and gifts. Overall, Rizvan is a time for unity, celebration, and reflection, and social media has made it easier for people to connect and share in this experience with others around the world.
